subject: Late planning notes
body:
Grid corrections for the next handover

Wanda's second slot was a proposal, not another workshop. The draft checkbox explains why both appeared. Priya has left the plan for Programs to amend instead of treating it as a technical failure.

The poster now uses the agreed meeting time. Zoe marked the earlier PDF DRAFT rather than letting a forwarded copy circulate without context.

Green has been used for available, checked and proposed. Replace those meanings with labels before exporting. Kofi also needs normal room bookings for late sessions; being green in a planning sheet does not reserve building space. Nils
title: Late planning notes
